item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02795","case1_error":"Uses the old monthly salary for all 41 new-company months, ignoring the 20% raise.","case2_error":"Computes new women as 100 − 30 + 10 instead of adding 10 to the initial 30 women.","reason":"The first omits a salary increase; the second uses an incorrect population-update relation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02796","case1_error":"Gives unsupported 6186 after correct formulas; the formulas yield 859 balloons per school.","case2_error":"Evaluates 150 − 15 − 30 − 30 as 85 instead of 75, propagating the error.","reason":"The first supplies an unsupported final number; the second explicitly miscalculates a correctly written expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02797","case1_error":"Leading answer 40 conflicts with an otherwise correct derivation and conclusion of 50 mph.","case2_error":"Concludes 26 necklaces despite correctly deriving 14, without supporting calculation.","reason":"Case 1 has only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared mathematical error mechanism cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02798","case1_error":"Adds three inches of increases to the 66-inch baseline, although Devin finishes only two inches above it.","case2_error":"Adds the five lost points to earned points instead of subtracting them.","reason":"The first measures growth from the wrong baseline; the second reverses the effect of a loss.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02799","case1_error":"Lists unsupported numerical answers after correct formulas; those formulas yield 3240 minutes.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported 2500 after correct formulas that yield 4500 pages.","reason":"Both provide incorrect final numbers without showing an erroneous relation or numerical evaluation.","judgment":"same"}]}
